description: YHACgrout-2101 is a multi-component, low-viscosity, and flexible polyacrylic injection system designed for permanent waterproof sealing with adjustable gelling time.
whereToUse: It is suitable for post-construction, external injection sealing system for construction, expansion and drainage pipe joints
new sealing walls in damp or water saturated ground conditions (curtain injection)
it is suitable for consolidation of soils that are not very compact
advantages: Capable of reversibly absorbing (swelling) and releasing (shrinking) moisture.
Adjustable gelling times at various temperature ranges.
Very low viscosity comparable to water, high permeability and capable of filling in fine cracks.
The cured YHACgrout-2101 is insoluble in water and hydrocarbons, and resistant to acids and alkalis.
Resistant to alternating freeze and thaw exposure.
notFor: it must also be ensured that there are no drainage systems or open pipes close to the injection areas
Prior to the use of YHACgrout-2101, check the gel time according to the local site ambient conditions.
Part A is sensitive to light and must be stored in and applied from light-proof containers.
YHACgrout-2101 must only be injected with a 2-part stainless steel injection pump with a special static mixer placed at the nozzle just before the injection point.

technicalData.value: in the ratio of 1:1 in volume

mixing: Mix parts A1 and A2 immediately before use. Part B2 is dissolved in Part B1 by thoroughly stirring it for 2-3 minutes with a suitable stirrer.
storage: The product should be stored in a well-ventilated, dry, and cool area, protected from sunlight, rain, frost and fire.
